summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, 4-cell indent per level). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, a width constraint in Align.__rich_console__ (measured max, capped by explicit width), and the public VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still collecting renderables with the argument. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 unreleased and adds an Added subsection with the two entries. Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render at height 6, VerticalCenter measurement) and tests/test_tree.py (tree measurement expecting Measurement(11, 19)). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; all verification was by reading the code.
